subject.title: [Bug]: active-memory embedded run cannot resolve Lossless Claw lcm_* tools despite runtime plugin inspect showing them registered

question: Should this issue wait for a live current-main Lossless Claw active-memory reproduction before a repair PR, or should maintainers sponsor a source-level registry fix from the existing logs?
rationale: The docs and source support the report, but the exact remaining boundary cannot be safely identified without running the external plugin path or accepting a maintainer-owned hypothesis.

options.title: Require live Lossless proof first
options.body: Keep this open for a focused Gateway reproduction with Lossless Claw installed, runtime inspect output captured, and active-memory lcm_* recall attempted on current main.

options.title: Sponsor source-level fix now
options.body: Allow a maintainer-guided repair PR to instrument or align embedded plugin tool registry resolution using the existing v2026.6.11 logs as the starting point.

options.title: Declare unsupported and validate config
options.body: If external context-engine tools are not meant to run in active-memory embedded recalls, update docs and config validation to warn or reject the Lossless Claw `toolsAllow` setup.

recommendation.title: Require live Lossless proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this open for a focused Gateway reproduction with Lossless Claw installed, runtime inspect output captured, and active-memory lcm_* recall attempted on current main.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the most recent adjacent merged work on embedded tool planning and authored the recent maintainer-side proof around the tool-prep invariant.
